ruleset.name: Custom Ruleset for CS304
ruleset.description: Custom PMD ruleset focusing on software metrics for CS304 assignment

rule.description: A class with too many lines of code indicates that it probably does too many things and violates the Single Responsibility Principle.
A method with too many lines of code becomes difficult to understand and maintain.

Cyclomatic complexity is determined by the number of linearly independent paths through a method body. A high cyclomatic complexity generally indicates over-complicated logic that should be broken down.
A class with too many methods is probably a good suspect for refactoring, in order to reduce its complexity and find a way to have more fine grained objects.
This rule counts the number of instantiations and method calls to other classes from a given class. High coupling indicates poor modularity and makes maintenance harder.
A God Class is a class that centralizes too much functionality and exhibits low cohesion. This suggests that the class is doing too many things and should be broken down into smaller classes.
